Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MA.
Our gross margin expanded by 112 basis points to 47.2%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2019.
We delivered record revenue of $49.3 billion this quarter, representing 20% year-over-year growth.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 20% to 11% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 805 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Revenue guidance of $49.3 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
